export.limitations: This is redacted raw measurement data, not an untouched original. Unknown strings are not automatically scrubbed; publication still requires content review.
export.policy: Reviewed generated fixtures and pinned offline dependency fixture only; explicit path-prefix substitutions in text, keys, decoded stdout/stderr and validated clone-sharing record paths. Re-encoded sharing payloads retain original digests and lengths alongside exported digests and lengths. Validated numeric scan stdout bytes, digests and lengths are unchanged; gzip headers are regenerated without optional metadata. Numeric observations are unchanged.

limits: A collection run is not full-suite acceptance; three consecutive complete campaigns are required.
Direct timing and wrapped resource samples are separate phases; read-only scans reuse a verified source.
Move/delete operands use ditto with no-follow symlink timestamp restoration, then strict independence and source checks before timing.
Direct CPU covers reaped children, not unrelated filesystem services.
Resource-pass CPU counters may round short commands to zero; this cannot establish a CPU win.
Block I/O counters are not physical device byte counts or APFS sharing measurements.
Source hashing may change access times, which are excluded; source identity and change times remain checked.
This runner covers copy, move, delete and opt-in scans, not the whole native-tool matrix.
